title.en: Assignment of Function to Land Transport Authority of Singapore

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 1 条。

text.en:
Land Transport Authority of Singapore Act
(Chapter 158A)
Assignment of Function to Land Transport Authority of Singapore
In exercise of the powers conferred by section 6(3) of the Land Transport Authority of Singapore Act, the Minister for Transport hereby assigns to the Land Transport Authority of Singapore, with effect from 2nd June 2008, the function of providing land transport for the purpose of road traffic management in relation to the Fédération Internationale de l’Automobile Formula One World Championship.
